name: Daern's Instant Fortress

source.note: Read against the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide text as aidedd.org prints it (three reads, 2026-10-18): a 1-inch adamantine statuette, a Magic action to set it down and again to shrink it (only when empty), a tower 20 ft square and 30 ft high, Bonus Action door, creatures and loose objects pushed clear (no saving throw or damage in this text), AC 20 and 100 HP for the roof, door and each wall, Wish repairs, Requires Attunement. The older cube and its 10d10 Dexterity save are gone.

powers.name: Raise the fortress
powers.text: Set the statuette on open ground and speak the word: a square adamantine tower, 20 ft on a side and 30 ft high, grows on the spot, its door facing you. Walk in at the door; rest inside in safety.

powers.name: Fold the fortress
powers.text: Speak the word again, within earshot of the tower: it shrinks back into the statuette, but only if nobody is inside.

summary: A tiny adamantine statuette that grows into a tower you can sleep safely in, and shrinks back when it is empty.
text: Set the 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and speak its command word (a Magic action): it swells at once into a square adamantine tower 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits in every wall and a battlement on top. Inside are two floors joined by a ladder, staircase or ramp of your choosing, and a trapdoor out onto the roof. One door stands at ground level on the side facing you, and it opens only at your command (a Bonus Action); Knock and magic like it can't open it. Creatures and loose objects where the tower appears are pushed clear to the nearest free space outside. Magic keeps it from tipping over. The roof, the door and each wall have AC 20 and 100 Hit Points, are immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage except from siege equipment, and resist all other damage. Speaking the command word again turns the tower back into the statuette, but only if nobody is inside, and that mends nothing: only a Wish spell repairs it, restoring all of a part's Hit Points. In the game, use the statuette in the open air to raise the tower where the party stands (it needs clear, level ground in front of you), walk in at its door, take the stair up to the sleeping floor, and rest in perfect safety; fold it up again from outside when the party is done. Foes cannot breach it.
